entities.summary: Julie Michelle Arblaster is an Australian scientist. She is a Professor in the School of Earth, Atmosphere and Environment at Monash University. She was a contributing author on reports for which the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) was a co-recipient of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize. Arblaster was a lead author on Chapter 12 of the IPCC Working Group I contribution to the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report in 2013. She has received the 2014 Anton Hales Medal for research in earth sciences from the Australian Academy of Science, and the 2017 Priestley Medal from the Australian Meteorological and Oceanographic Society.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a leading climate scientist and Professor at Monash University, Julie Arblaster contributed significantly to the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report, shaping our understanding of climate change impacts. Her work has informed global policy decisions and research efforts.
